name: Have you identified the security risks related to third-party Managed Service Providers (MSPs) prior to using them?
conditionsText:
Applies when:
- Outsourcing support services
- Using managed hosting
- Using managed security services
- Using outsourced operational teams
requirementTitle: Have you identified the security risks related to third-party Managed Service Providers (MSPs) prior to using them?
requirementDescription: Before appointing an external provider to deliver or operate services on your behalf, have you assessed the risks they introduce?
why:
MSPs often receive significant access to:
- Systems
- Infrastructure
- Data
- Administrative accounts
A security weakness within the MSP can become a security weakness in your service.
Secure by Design requires security due diligence on third-party providers
